Support Operations · Live System

Support SLA & Escalation Monitor

A support operations system for Zuri Fragrances that tracks every ticket against its SLA, auto-triages new tickets by priority, and alerts the team on Slack when an urgent ticket needs attention. Written up as a persona-led case study following Fatima the customer, David the agent, and Ngozi the support lead.

FastAPISQLiteMakeGoogle SheetsSlackRender

Outcome: 83 tickets tracked live: 60 resolved, 20 open and 3 in progress. First response SLA at 54.3%, resolution at 45.0%, with 10 tickets awaiting a first reply surfaced on one dashboard.

Read the case study Live dashboard May take a few seconds to wake up View code
How I built it
  • Seeded a SQLite database with 83 support tickets and set SLA targets by priority: urgent 4h / 24h, high 12h / 48h, normal 24h / 72h for first response and resolution
  • Built a FastAPI bridge with an auto-triage endpoint that sets priority and calculates deadlines for each new ticket
  • Connected Make to log tickets to Google Sheets and send Slack alerts for urgent tickets
  • Built a live dashboard on Render showing SLA performance, open breaches, and tickets awaiting a first reply
  • Wrote the case study in persona form, with the full tech stack and a step by step view of how a ticket moves through the system

Support Operations · Live System

Merchant Support Triage & SLA Monitor

A support hub for Nile, a commerce platform for small merchants, built because their merchants had no way to track a support request. Ticket portal, track-my-request, support inbox and auto-triage against real SLA targets, plus a live AI agent that answers from the support guide, creates tickets and escalates critical issues to a human.

Ticket raised→Auto-triage→SLA tracked→Human escalation
AI Support AgentSLA TrackingTicket PortalGeminiVercelServerless

Outcome: 16 seeded tickets with live triage. AI agent verified end to end on a real storefront-down report: ticket NIL-1017, Premium merchant, flagged Critical, human promised within the hour.

Try the live hub View code
How I built it
  • Mapped Nile's real support setup first: email-only, no ticket tracking, SLA up to 4 hours for a down storefront
  • Built the ticket portal, track-my-request page and support inbox with auto-triage that sets priority from the issue type and merchant plan
  • Set SLA targets from Nile's real ones: Critical 1 hour for Premium and 4 hours for Standard, with 24 and 72 hour resolution targets labelled as proposed
  • Added a live AI support agent on Gemini that answers from the support guide, checks ticket status, creates tickets and escalates urgent cases to a human
  • Verified the full flow live: a storefront-down report opened ticket NIL-1017, flagged it Critical and gave the right first-response time for a Premium merchant
